name: OMeetingBar
author: Manuel Knitza
description: MeetingBar for Omarchy: your next Google Calendar meeting in the bar, an agenda popup, and a fullscreen alert before a meeting starts that you cannot miss.

barWidget.description: Your next meeting in the bar. Left click opens the agenda for today and tomorrow, right or middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Full colour from (minutes)
schema.description: This long before the start the bar entry shows its colour at full strength; before that it is slightly dimmed.

schema.label: Maximum title length (characters)
schema.description: Longer meeting titles are truncated in the bar.

schema.label: Hide when the agenda is empty
schema.description: Off: the entry is always visible. On: it disappears only once the agenda holds no meetings at all – while it shows anything, the entry stays reachable as a dimmed placeholder.
